name: per-word-rise
description: Words or characters rise into place in a controlled blur-to-sharp cascade, settle softly on landing, and hold still until the cut (optional fade or up exit).

vars.description: Text whose words or characters rise into place.
Animate the text as words or individual characters.
Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each unit landing. Empty keeps the authored cascade rhythm.
Contract accent token used for the text color.
Optional departure. Default none: the line holds until the frame cuts.
